objects.taxonomy_description: A small, flat, baked food item typically characterized by a crisp or chewy texture and sweet flavor profile.

Head broad with wide muzzle. Horns curved laterally and upward (if not dehorned). Eyes large and dark with wide field of vision. Ears large and mobile. Neck thick and muscular with prominent dewlap. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, hair insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Composite flower with a central yellow disc surrounded by a single whorl of white ray petals (florets). The flower head measures 2-5 cm in diameter with 13-34 elongated white petals radiating outward from the bright yellow center. The petals are narrow, slightly pointed, and arranged in a flat, circular pattern. The flower is supported by a slender green stem with small alternate leaves. The center disc has a bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.
